body:
Ok so the issue here is that the currentRefinedValues is not reading generic searchParameters, only refinements: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blame/e81c320a0f025332c9fdbb4bb0177eada54216cd/src/lib/utils.js#L159

geoloc is only a searchParameter, what we could do is that if we find a match for the name of the attribute inside the searchParameters then we accept it. So that you do not have to declare a fake facet.
